# Missing Error Handling on GitHub Gateway

The _gateway function assumes the repository's forge reference is in the expected format (github.com/<owner>/<repo>). If it is not, it raises an error. This could lead to unhandled errors if the forge_ref does not match, potentially causing the CLI to crash without feedback to the user.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli._gateway`
